abstract: In this column, we provide interesting historical briefs from the Journal articles of days past. The purpose of this column is primarily entertainment, but we hope it will also stimulate your thinking and reflection on the Society's history, how far we have come in the industry, and (sometimes) how some things never change. This column is sponsored by Television Broadcast Technology, Inc., since March, 2001: http://ieeexplore.ieee.org/stamp/stamp.jsp?tp=&arnumber=7257346
